title: Long Tenancy and the Cure Period of a Home-Site Lease Nonpayment Notice
content:
**Collections standard — tenure extension**

The cure period of a nonpayment notice on a Home-Site Lease is lengthened by a tenure extension, in days, read from the full calendar months of tenancy since the move-in date on the lease.

| Full months of tenancy since the move-in date | Tenure extension |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 3 days |
| at least 60 but fewer than 120 | 2 days |
| fewer than 60 | none |

**At the thresholds**

| Tenure | Extension |
|---|---|
| 121 months | 3 days |
| exactly 120 months | 3 days |
| 119 months | 2 days |
| exactly 60 months | 2 days |
| 59 months | none |

*Hypothetical.* A resident who moved in on 15 March 2016 and is served on 4 May 2026 has 121 full months of tenancy: the cure period is lengthened by 3 days.
